text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method in 5-7 business days.
Items are covered by a 12-month warranty against defects. We send a free replacement once you share a photo of the defect.
If an item arrives damaged, send a photo within 48 hours of delivery and we ship a free replacement. You don't need to return the damaged item.
If you received the wrong item, we email a prepaid return label and ship the correct item as soon as the carrier scans the return.
Return shipping is free for defective or wrong items. For other returns, a $6 label fee is deducted from the refund.
Gifts can be returned within 30 days of delivery and are refunded as store credit to the recipient. The buyer is not notified.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and express takes 1-2 business days. A tracking email is sent when your order ships.
If tracking shows no movement for 7 days, we reissue the order or refund it in full. Please contact us within 30 days of the ship date.
If tracking says delivered but nothing arrived, check with neighbors and household members for 24 hours, then contact us and we will open a carrier investigation.
Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them under Account > Orders. After that the order ships and can be returned once it arrives.
We can update the shipping address until the order ships. Once it has shipped, the carrier cannot redirect it, so please contact us before then.
We ship to the US and Canada only. Canadian orders take 5-10 business days and may owe import duties on delivery.
Confirmed duplicate charges are reversed within 3-5 business days. A pending authorization drops off automatically within 5 days.
You can cancel any time under Settings > Billing. Access continues until the end of the paid period.
If an item's price drops within 14 days of your purchase, we refund the difference once per order. Price matching with other stores is not offered.
Promo codes must be entered at checkout and can't be combined or added to an order after it is placed.
If your card is declined, check that the billing address matches the card and try again, or pay with PayPal. We never see your full card number.
Invoices are under Account > Orders: open the order and choose Download invoice.
Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 60 minutes.
After 5 failed sign-in attempts an account locks for 30 minutes, then you can try again or use Forgot password.
Changing the email on an account requires a verification code sent to the current email address.
If you lost your two-factor device, sign in with one of your backup codes. Without backup codes, identity verification takes 2-3 business days.
You can delete your account under Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion becomes permanent after 30 days; signing in before then cancels it.
Update to the latest app version and restart. If the problem continues, send your device model and OS version so engineering can investigate.
If the website shows an error, clear your browser cache and try again in a private window. If it persists, send us the page link and a screenshot.
Turn order and marketing notifications on or off under Settings > Notifications. Marketing emails also have an unsubscribe link at the bottom.
Orders placed as a guest don't appear in your account automatically. Add one under Account > Orders > Find an order, using the order number and email.
Northwind Rewards points post 14 days after delivery and expire after 12 months without a purchase.
Gift cards never expire, can be used on any order and can't be exchanged for cash.
Northwind Goods is online only. We have no physical stores or pickup locations.
